title: "Shall We Dig Deeper?": Designing and Evaluating Strategies for LLM Agents to Advance Knowledge Co-Construction in Asynchronous Online Discussions
reasoning: The paper focuses on designing and evaluating intervention strategies for LLM agents to improve the quality of online knowledge co-construction.
